## Functional summary

This 194-amino-acid protein is **imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase (IGPD)**, an enzyme in **L-histidine biosynthesis**. The sequence is an exact, full-length match to the reviewed *Persephonella marina* protein UniProt **C0QUG8**; the IGPD Pfam domain (PF00475) is detected at residues 31–174.

IGPD catalyzes a dehydration step in histidine synthesis: imidazoleglycerol phosphate is converted to an imidazole-containing oxopropyl phosphate plus water (**EC 4.2.1.19; Rhea RHEA:11040**). The reference annotation places it at **step 6 of 9** in the pathway.

**Subcellular location:** Cytoplasm, according to the exact-match reference annotation.

The functional assignment is high-confidence because of the exact sequence match. The pathway and localization are database annotations for that reference protein; they were not independently experimentally tested here.
